why_it_matters.text: A tricyclic antidepressant, also used for nerve pain. It is what the body turns amitriptyline into.

description: A tricyclic antidepressant, also used for nerve pain. It is what the body turns amitriptyline into. Nortriptyline (C19H21N, 263 g/mol) is a tricyclic antidepressant dispensed on prescription.
